About the Project

"We Want a Chiefs Christmas" is part of the Rogue Round Table project — a Kansas City nonprofit using creativity and technology to give back. Produced through IDSAI, this community-powered album is 100% donation-supported, and every dollar raised goes back into helping Kansas City families this winter.
